details: An interim deal between the US and Iran is reportedly under discussion, aiming to de-escalate conflicts spanning from the Strait of Hormuz to Lebanon. This agreement could allow Iran to resume oil and fuel sales, potentially easing global energy market pressures. However, skepticism remains, particularly from Republicans demanding full details. Simultaneously, Israeli airstrikes on Lebanon are continuing despite the reported deal, with Israel asserting it will not "relent," which threatens the agreement. Former President Trump has also stated he would revert to military action if he disapproves of the final terms. The broader economic impact, including a potentially softer hit from the Iran situation on UK inflation and central banks holding interest rates steady, is also being observed.
title: US-Iran Deal Emerges, But Middle East Tensions Persist

details: Leaders from the G7 nations have collectively pledged to enhance Ukraine's air defense capabilities and tighten existing sanctions against Russia. French President Emmanuel Macron highlighted the strong alignment with the United States on this shared commitment. Meanwhile, former US President Donald Trump, speaking at the G7 summit, expressed his hope that Europe would "find its way" on issues like immigration and energy, potentially hinting at future shifts in geopolitical priorities or alliance dynamics.
title: G7 Boosts Ukraine Aid, Sanctions Russia
